title: NOIR: Autonomous Multimodal Robot Assistant
description: A mobile robot running vision, voice and hardware control as concurrent supervised loops in Python. Fully local voice: openWakeWord hotword, Faster-Whisper STT on CUDA, Gemma 4 via Ollama, Piper TTS. Vision covers YOLOv8 person tracking, a fine-tuned MobileNetV2 line follower with an OpenCV fallback, and a Gemma 4 vision-language-action mode. ESP32 firmware on FreeRTOS drives the motors with a failsafe that cuts power if the brain goes quiet, commands are allow-list validated, and 93 tests cover unit to resilience suites. Flutter app for live telemetry and manual control.
